description: This file defines the 'SandboxExtension' class which extends 'AbstractExtension'. It provides sandbox security features for Twig templates by managing security policies, checking method and property allowances, and controlling sandbox activation.

classes.name: SandboxExtension
classes.description: A Twig extension that provides sandbox security features, including policy enforcement and method/property checks for templates.

methods.name: getTokenParsers
methods.description: Returns an array with an instance of 'SandboxTokenParser' for parsing sandbox-related tags.

methods.name: getNodeVisitors
methods.description: Returns an array with an instance of 'SandboxNodeVisitor' for node visiting during compilation.

methods.name: isSandboxed
methods.description: Checks if sandboxing is active globally, locally, or for the given source.

methods.name: isSandboxedGlobally
methods.description: Checks if sandboxing is enabled globally.

methods.name: getSecurityPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves the current security policy object.

methods.name: checkSecurity
methods.description: Validates security for tags, filters, and functions if sandboxed.

methods.name: checkMethodAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a method call on an object is permitted under the security policy.

methods.name: checkPropertyAllowed
methods.description: Checks if access to a property on an object is permitted.

methods.name: ensureToStringAllowed
methods.description: Ensures that an object is allowed to be converted to a string under the sandbox rules.

methods.name: ensureToStringAllowedForArray
methods.description: Recursively checks array elements to ensure string conversion is allowed under sandbox.
